alex: Short follow-up from the postmortem — recurring pattern = KV cold-window + p95 spikes for tiny requests. need owners for remediation + tests.
mina: I'll own the regression additions. plan: 3 lightweight cases (1-token batch, mixed-small batches, prefix-eviction) added to nightly and a targeted PR gate for infra/runtime changes. ETA 2024-05-10. ticket RED-2530.
jordan: I'll curate prompt sets that trigger the model/cache mismatch and add automated scoring so we have objective regressions. ETA 2024-05-07. RED-2531.
tim: I'll own load-scenario updates and schedule a focused chaos drill to exercise KV resharding and short-lived bursts. proposing 2024-05-02 for drill. will add SLO-violation scenarios to the load suite. RED-2532.
sophia: I'll add KV cold-hit metrics to the perf dashboard and a synthetic that replays the spike every 12h so we can spot regressions. ETA 2024-05-05. RED-2533.
runbook-bot: Runbook posted: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cold-window (auto)
alex: Process asks: PR template for postmortem-driven tests (owner, how to reproduce, perf budget) and labeling convention postmortem/RED-####. I'll draft both and push by EOD.
mina: :thumbsup: accepting RED-2530.
jordan: :thumbsup: accepting RED-2531.
tim: :thumbsup: scheduling drill and calendar invite.
sophia: :thumbsup: will add dashboard tiles.
alex: Action summary (tracking epic RED-2529): - RED-2530: Mina  regression tests (3 cases) + PR gate  ETA 2024-05-10 - RED-2531: Jordan  prompt set + eval scoring  ETA 2024-05-07 - RED-2532: Tim  chaos drill + load scenarios  drill date 2024-05-02 - RED-2533: Sophia  KV instrumentation + synthetic  ETA 2024-05-05
Please react with :thumbsup: if you accept or propose new dates. I'll keep the epic updated.
